newsitem.title: USA: N.J. says collected $8.8 bln so far in fiscal 1997.
newsitem.headline: N.J. says collected $8.8 bln so far in fiscal 1997.

text.p: New Jersey Treasurer Brian Clymer said the state collected more than $8.8 billion in the first seven months of fiscal 1997, about in line with revised budget projections.
January collections were $1.35 billion, 1.2 percent higher than the projections, according to a statement released by Clymer's office.
The year-to-date corporate business tax collections were $663 million through January, or 4.1 percent higher than expected.
The sales tax collection figure was $2.56 billion, which matched projections. For the month of January, sales tax collections were $308 million, slightly below the projected level.
The gross income tax generated $2.7 billion for the first seven months of the fiscal year, about 0.1 percent below expectations.
